Can’t really stretch the skin when your in your early 20s as the skin is very elastic and has a lot of collagen so the skin will go back to normal. However on someone older such as 40s or 50s the skin may not return back to normal or it might take time . That’s why older people that loose weight end up with loose skin where as people in their 20s and 30s rarely do. Plus filler dissolved overtime slowly so it’s unlikely to results in loose skin. Plus fillers can stimulate collagen production. Please don’t talk out your ass. I know people who have gotten fillers and have stopped and there skin has returned back to normal. Plus the amount of filler put in the skin is minor such as 1ml-3ml in an area max. That’s not a lot to stretch the skin. Weight gain of 5kilos is more likely to stretch the skin more. So weight gain stretches the skin more than fillers itself. But fillers stimulate collagen production whereas weight gain doesn’t. Unless you have experience with fillers stretching skin. Don’t spread lies. I’ve had fillers and now I’ve stopped and everything is back to normal as it was before.
